name: autron
description: Analyze and manage your Amazon ads: performance by account, product and campaign, the changes you ask for, and Autron's help centre.

interface.longDescription:
Autron is an AI agent for Amazon and Walmart advertising, built for sellers, brands and agencies. In ChatGPT, it connects to your Amazon Ads and Seller Central accounts.

Ask about ACoS, TACoS, spend, sales and profit by campaign, search term or product, and it answers from your own data. It also makes the changes you ask for to bids, targets and campaigns, and to the goals Autron's ad engine works towards. Changes to bids, targets and campaigns are recorded in your Autron action log.

Making changes needs an Autron account that includes them; other accounts can read. You can revoke access at any time from Settings › AI assistants in Autron.

Autron is a Walmart Connect partner, and you manage your Walmart ads in the Autron app, beside Amazon.
defaultPrompt: How did my Amazon ads perform over the last 30 days?
Show me my top 5 ASINs by ad sales over the last 30 days.
Break my ad performance down by parent product.

positive.description: Account-level performance summary for a recent date range, compared with the period before.
positive.prompt: How did my Amazon ads perform over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Ad spend, ad sales and ACoS for the last 30 days for the connected seller, with clicks and orders, compared with the previous 30 days.

positive.description: Product-level ranking over a supported reporting window, from the account's per-ASIN breakdown.
positive.prompt: Show me my top 3 ASINs by ad sales over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: The three ASINs with the most ad sales over the last 30 days, ranked, each with its product name and ad sales.

positive.description: Connection context: which seller accounts the signed-in user can see.
positive.prompt: Which Amazon seller accounts can you see on this connection?
positive.expected_behavior: The seller accounts the signed-in user can access, each with its name and marketplace, and which one is active. The test account has one: Quillfern Coffee Co., United States.

positive.description: Change a campaign's Top of Search placement adjustment to an exact percentage the user names.
positive.prompt: Set the Top of Search bid adjustment on my campaign "SP B0QFDEMO06 | reusable coffee filter paper | exact" to 50%.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the campaign and sets its Top of Search adjustment to +50% (once the user confirms, if ChatGPT asks first), leaving its other placements unchanged, then replies with the old and new percentage. Running the test again leaves it at +50%.

positive.description: Change one keyword's bid to an exact amount the user names.
positive.prompt: Set the bid on my exact-match keyword "reusable coffee filter paper" to $0.70.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the keyword and sets its bid to $0.70 (once the user confirms, if ChatGPT asks first), then replies with the old and new bid. Running the test again leaves the bid at $0.70.

positive.description: Audit trail: the changes made to the account through Autron's agent tools.
positive.prompt: What changes has Autron's agent made to my ads in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: The changes made through Autron's agent tools in the last 7 days, newest first, each with what changed, when and who made it. After the two tests above, they include the placement and bid changes. Changes made by Autron's ad engine are not part of this log, and the reply may say so.

positive.description: Help-centre lookup that needs no account data.
positive.prompt: How does Autron decide when to raise or lower a bid?
positive.expected_behavior: An explanation drawn from Autron's help centre of how the ad engine sets bids: a fresh bid for every keyword and target every hour, worked out from the last 90 days, the product's goal and each keyword's conversion rate.

negative.description: Do not trigger for shopping on Amazon; the app manages advertising, not purchases.
negative.prompt: Order me a 6mm yoga mat from Amazon.

negative.description: Do not trigger for other ad platforms.
negative.prompt: How did my Google Ads campaigns do last month?

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated requests.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Seattle tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: Adds changes from ChatGPT. On Autron accounts that include them, users can now change bids, targets and campaigns, and set the goals Autron's ad engine works towards. Changes to bids, targets and campaigns are recorded in the Autron action log. Reading works as before.
